name: Min
about: Min is Zei's mother in Pafogai Du, who travels abroad for the first time with him. The book does not describe her appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Mom said she needs to sleep
He had been hoping to be able to buy his mom a new compute box
facts.fact: Zei wants to buy her a compute box.

facts.quote: his mom had already watched him heal from one bomb
facts.fact: Watched Zei recover from his injury.
